label: Grounded thinking cone members have an earlier distinct thinking ancestor
paraphrase: Analyst formulation: for each bearer b of an occurring thought, each actual concrete ancestor x of b that bears an occurring thought and has at least one incoming actual concrete ground has a distinct earlier thinking ancestor c along a nonempty finite ground path. Its immediate ground need not be a thinker, and x need not be contingent. No logical or idealist theory by itself supplies this bridge.
